reviewed_endpoint_rules: scan begins at line start after conditional literal-space skip; first NUL treated as string end
while current not NUL/LF: compare extended scaled next width against unsigned-converted container before float spill
on overflowing space decrement scan before postscan; on other overflow leave scan at overflowing unit
if an accepted nonspace exists and current scan unit is space: decrement scan, decrement accepted-space count and subtract unscaled space advance from saved width until current not space
last-space pointer is not updated by that rewind
next=start of next emission pass: if stopNUL use scan; if stopLF or accepted-space count0 use scan+1; otherwise use last_accepted_space+1
saved width is overwritten by CVTTSS2SI full accepted scan width if saved value0 or stopNUL/LF
emission processes every code unit through next pointer, including LF and overflowed unbroken-word code unit
important_asymmetries: LF terminates scanner but reaches emission and uses scaled nonspace pen branch despite selecting space/LF payload.
Only literal0020 is a whitespace gap; tabs use ordinary glyph lookup.
Scanner scales spaces; emitted spaces use unscaled natural or justified gap.
Emitted-line width adds raw nonspace advances, not scaled pen advances.
Backward scanner adjustment does not change last-space pointer, so emission can retain those spaces.
Alignment saved width is signed32 CVTTSS2SI then modular DWORD subtraction; it is not direct float slack.
Line-height arithmetic uses signed font height; quad uses low unsigned16.
Vertical offset is applied after geometry normalization.
